events.name: Melt Banana + MPC Lafote
events.description:
MELT-BANANA kommen aus Tokio/Japan. Der intensive Sound von MELT-BANANA ist längst eine Institution – für Fans, Kritiker*Innen ebenso wie für Musiker*Innen, die sich von komplexen Strukturen und Arrangements nicht abschrecken lassen.
Zahlreiche Singles und Samplerbeiträge, 12½ Alben sowie Konzerte auf der ganzen Welt: Mit ihrem harten, experimentellen und einzigartigen Sound sind MELT-BANANA zu einem festen Bestandteil der Musikgeschichte geworden.


Es überrascht daher nicht, dass viele Fans von MELT-BANANA selbst MusikerInnen sind, die die Komplexität und das hohe Niveau von MxBx erkennen und schätzen. Ebenso wenig ist es ein Zufall, dass Künstlerinnen wie JOHN ZORN, TOOL, MIKE PATTON, FANTOMAS, WIRE, UNDERWORLD, MELVINS oder der leider viel zu früh verstorbene LOU REED mit ihnen zusammengearbeitet haben.
MELT-BANANA bestehen aus Sängerin Yasuko Onuki („Yako“) und Gitarrist Ichiro Agata („Agata“) . Agatas Gitarrensound wird oft beschrieben wie ein Mix aus Plattenspielern, Synthesizern und Samplern, die zwischen sechs Gitarrensaiten verborgen ist – und diesen unverwechselbaren „Hypertension Sound“ erzeugt.

MELT-BANANA-Konzerte hinterlassen nachhaltige Eindrücke: sympathische Musiker*Innen, eine magische Atmosphäre, enorme Lautstärke, überraschende Effekte innerhalb der Songs und ein nahezu perfekter Umgang mit ihren Instrumenten. Grindcore-Riffs, aufgeladen mit unerwarteten Effekten, scharfe Shouts und massiver Druck. Innerhalb von Sekunden denkt man an Kunst, Noise, Punk, Metal, Riot Grrrl, Grindcore, Popkultur oder an den Soundtrack eines aufregenden Films.
Sind MELT-BANANA eine Noise-Band? Eine Punk-Band? Techno-Pop? Diese Frage ist letztlich irrelevant – denn MELT-BANANA lassen sich nicht kategorisieren. Die Band steht für Innovation und Fortschritt. Ihr Sound spielt in einer völlig eigenen Liga und gilt als stilprägend für zahlreiche Bands im weiten Feld von „Noise“ und „Rock“.

“You cannot just listen to Melt-Banana; you must experience Melt-Banana” (John Peel)

events.name: Doomed Metropolis II
events.description:
The second edition of will take place at Neue Zukunft, bringing together some of the finest names in contemporary underground doom metal for a night of crushing heaviness, melancholic atmospheres, and emotional intensity.

Evadne from Spain are celebrating 20 years of creating powerful melodic doom/death metal, combining crushing riffs, orchestral arrangements, and deeply emotional melodies that move between despair, beauty, and catharsis. Over two decades, they have become one of the most respected names in the European doom scene, consistently delivering immersive and intense live performances.
In 2025, Evadne marked their anniversary with a special tour across South America, bringing their epic and melancholic sound to fans across the continent. Now, for the first time in Berlin, they will headline Doomed Metropolis 2026, closing the festival with a monumental performance that promises to be unforgettable.

Unverkalt is a German-Greek post-metal project, now based in Berlin, that blends atmospheric, dark soundscapes with powerful intensity, avant-garde structures, and a cinematic approach, combining elements of doom, post-metal, and black metal. Their music is inspired by European cinema, visual arts, and the human experience, resulting in immersive, emotionally charged compositions.
With their third album, Héréditaire, Unverkalt deliver what critics are calling their strongest and most expressive work yet — a dark, complex listening experience that balances hypnotic passages with explosive intensity and has received outstanding reviews across the underground scene.

Woe Unto Me is an Eastern European doom ensemble that creates melancholic soundscapes and brooding atmospheres, taking listeners on a journey through the abyss of the human psyche. Their latest work, Along the Meandering Ordeals, Reshape the Pivot of Harmony, exemplifies their unique approach to doom metal, blending intricate, evocative compositions with emotional depth.
Traversing landscapes of sorrow, hope, and introspection, Woe Unto Me redefine the boundaries of the genre, inviting listeners to embrace the darkness within and emerge transformed. The band has appeared at festivals such as Brutal Assault, Darken The Moon, Metal Gates Festival, and Doom Over Vienna.

Wooden Veins is a project of Chilean musicians now spread across different parts of Europe, with their creative headquarters in Berlin. Its members are seasoned musicians who have played in bands such as Mar de Grises, Poema Arcanus, and Mourning Sun, among others. The band blends the epic weight of classic doom metal with progressive, expansive, and melancholic soundscapes full of atmosphere and emotional depth.
The band has established itself within the European doom scene in recent years and has already toured Europe and appeared at festivals such as Darken the Moon, Under the Doom, Dutch Doom Days, and Doom Over Vienna.

Voidhaven was formed in Hamburg in 2016 by a group of experienced musicians also known for their work with Ophis, Fvneral Fvkk and Remembrance. Blending melancholic doom metal with elements of death metal, the band creates a dense and immersive atmosphere where crushing heaviness meets haunting melodies and introspective themes.
Following their self-titled debut EP released in 2018, the band continued to refine their sound, culminating in the release of their full-length album Lithic in 2023. With their oppressive yet captivating sonic landscapes, Voidhaven stand as a powerful presence within the European doom underground.

They’re all that, and more: kind, grateful, hilarious, energetic, no-holds-barred rock‘n’roll, 187% no top 100 shit, simple One-Riff-Trash.

The Monsters played Europe, Asia, las Americas, Africa and everywhere in between with greats like Guitar Wolf, Death, The Sonics, Ty Segall and Black Lips in countless fancy places like CBGBs and DIY punkholes around the world as well as festivals like Speedfest, Cosmic Trip, Sjock, We’re Loud Fest (Asia, Africa), Bad Bonn Chilbi, Muddy Roots and many more.

They played on a whole lot of recordings and will release their latest, newest, most recent and most exciting platter in late 2026, followed by tours-a-gogo through the world. Because this is just what they do.

Go see them while you can.

events.name: The Clockworks + Danny Blue
events.description:
Die vierköpfige irische Band The Clockworks begeistern ganz Europa mit ihren Auftritten bei Festivals und Fernsehauftritten. Sie selbst bezeichnen sich als „the Punkrock version of The Streets“.


Wer auf die Post-Punk-Palette im Stile von Fontaines DC und The Murder Capital steht, kommt an The Clockworks nicht vorbei. In Galway gegründet und in London beheimatet wird die Band von einer gegenseitigen Wertschätzung und Liebe zur Musik der Vergangenheit und Gegenwart getragen.


Die Band ist bei Alan McGees neuestem Label-Unternehmen „It’s Creation Baby“ unter Vertrag. Auf The Clockworks wurde er erstmals 2019 aufmerksam, als Gitarrist Sean Connelly ihm auf Instagram eine Nachricht schickte: „McGee: We’re the Punkrock version of the Streets.“ McGee war von einem der Demos beeindruckt genug, um eine ihrer Proben zu Hause in Galway zu sehen, bei der Frontmann James McGregor mit solcher Intensität auftrat, dass er seinen Mikrofonständer zerbrach. McGee war der Meinung, dass es die beste Probe war, die er seit der frühen Oasis gesehen hatte, und nahm sie am selben Abend unter Vertrag.


Seitdem beeindruckten sie das Publikum in ganz Europa mit ihren Auftritten bei Festivals wie dem Eurosonic und Electric Picnic, traten vor einer riesigen Menschenmenge im Sefton Park in Liverpool zur Unterstützung von Kings of Leon auf, sowie einem aufsehenerregenden Fernsehauftritt bei Sky 1s Soccer AM. Und auch die Medien und Kritiker haben ihre Begeisterung schnell gezeigt. Das Louder Than War Magazine schreibt: „devilish eccentricity and high energy. They look as sharp as they sound” und CLASH lobt überschwänglich „ferocious sense of purpose, with the careering post-punk guitar lines”.


Auf ihrer Single „Feels So Real“ atmen The Clockworks jedes Teilchen ihrer neu gefundenen Heimat London ein und atmen eine Flut von Lärm, Energie und Atmosphäre aus, die das Leben in der Hauptstadt mit all seinen berauschenden, erschöpfenden Nuancen einfängt. Im April 2022 erschien die neue self-titled EP, mit der vorherigen Single-Auskopplung „Endgame“.

Victoryland (Experimental Pop-Rock)

For fans of: Alex G, Kurt Vile, Sufjan Stevens

Victoryland is the Brooklyn-based project of musician Julian McCamman and Dan Howard. Their label debut, My Heart Is A Room With No Cameras In It, released January 23, 2026, via Good English, is a triumphant, despondent, and ultimately fun experimental pop-rock album. My Heart wrangles with heavy subject matter (love, disconnection, sexual frustration, emptiness, etc.), but the terminal statement of the record is about the cleansing nature of pop music. That, if a song can force you to “bliss out” over a hook or a loop, or even make you dance, it can be the spoonful of sugar to swallow the hard pill with; this is what Victoryland strives to do: package the most exhausting realities of life, love, and the search for connection in a world starved of it, into a fun 2-5 minutes, and for the runtime of Victoryland’s first major statement, you might even feel like you’re not alone.

Their intense live shows have taken them to renowned festivals such as Summer Breeze Open Air and stages alongside some of the genre's most respected acts.

Expect a celebration of atmospheric black and post metal at its most captivating.

events.name: Godzilla in the Kitchen + Mudfinger
events.description:
Three musicians. Two continents. A new beginning.

Welcome to the next stage in the evolution of Godzilla In The Kitchen.

In 2019, Thiago Presto escaped the dangerous favelas of Rio de Janeiro and emigrated to Leipzig. Five years later, in 2024, the German progressive, psychedelic groove rock band Godzilla In The Kitchen faced a crisis. Musicians Simon Ulm and Eric Patzschke lost their drummer and struggled to rebuild their trio. However, giving up was never an option for the band, which had already reached major milestones like performing at Wacken Open Air in 2022.

A chain of coincidences brought Thiago Presto behind the drum kit. He infused the band's groove rock with an explosive dose of power and traditional Maracatu rhythms.

This lineup change completely transformed their sound. Moving away from purely instrumental music, Simon Ulm took over vocal duties to address contemporary world events and deep emotions. What was once an instrumental rock group has now evolved into a powerful alternative metal machine with poignant lyrics. Their new sonic identity is fully realized in their upcoming third album, Termination Sequence.

Termination Sequence will be released on October 23, 2026, in cooperation with Tonzonen Records. You can experience the trio live on their "Termination Sequence" Release Tour 2026. Joining them as support are their stoner metal brothers from Mudfinger, ready to fire up the crowd with heavy riffs and driving drums.

events.description:
Elephant Stone and Sacred Buzz are teaming up at Neue Zukunft for an exclusive double album release show.

At the center of Montreal’s Elephant Stone is Rishi Dhir, a songwriter and sitarist who has spent twenty years blurring the lines between Western psych-pop and Indian classical traditions. Operating out of his home studio, Dhir has emerged as a true studio auteur—producing, engineering, and mixing the band’s increasingly complex and cinematic output. While built on airtight pop craftsmanship, their recent work—anchored by Miles Dupire, Robbie MacArthur, and Jason Kent—possesses a new, raw intensity forged through collaborations with icons like The Black Angels, The Brian Jonestown Massacre, and Beck. With 10 acclaimed releases, Elephant Stone remains at the forefront of the modern psych movement.

Berlin’s own psychedelic outfit Sacred Buzz will present their debut self-titled album, out October 9 on Sound Effect Records. Showcasing a turn to a more expansive sound, the band will unleash the full force of their fuzz-drenched, groove-locked dimensions. The LP explores the nature of reality through sci-fi and philosophical ideas, woven together with cinematic twists and vivid imagery. Surreal lyrics emerge from an echoing voice, while a locked-in krautrock groove anchors your body to the earth. Raw, reverberating guitars and droning organ textures complete their rich sonic palette.

Their sound came from ancient pyramids and desert caravans - from the fusion jazz of 70s ’till the stoner grooves of the millenium. Their first EP, Gathering Axis, was released in 2025, and a year after they are dropping the bands first LP “Reincarnation of a moment” in 2026 november.

Abanamat’s music propels you through space and time at light speed - while standing perfectly still. It’s heavy yet ethereal, intense yet serene. Based in Berlin, this genre-defying quartet brings together musicians from different counties, creating a rich cultural fusion that shapes their distinctive atmospheric sound.

Their compositions blend jazzy chord progressions and Afrobeat-inspired rhythms with crushing riffs and soaring solos, crafting a sonic experience that is as heady as it is hard-hitting. Abanamat delivers a sound that speaks to the soul while shaking the ground beneath your feet - pure ecstasy for any headbanger.

events.name: Water Damage + Gavial + Gaffa Gandhi
events.description:
Drone Ensemble Water Damage for the second time in Berlin!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


Water Damage - US | 12XU

https://waterdamage12xu.bandcamp.com/

Genre: Maximal Repetition Minimal Deviation

FFO: Swans, Sun(O))), Boredoms, Shit and Shine


There is something really special about music based on drones. Whether it’s the vocals of Pandit Pran Nath, the ARP 2500 of Eliane Radigue, or the nearly-blown amps of Sunn O))), by changing the listeners’s focus on details to one that favors flow, drones are uniquely capable of transporting our brains far far away. The music of Water Damage, the loudly droning Austin collective is a goddamn splendid example of how the process works. Using the motto, “Maximal Repetition Minimal Deviation,” Water Damage create glowing fields of drones that pretty much suck you right in and boil you alive. They prefer if each of their sonic ideas takes up a whole reel of tape, and once they start they don’t look back. Everything proceeds towards an imaginary end point that is only achieved when the tape starts flapping.

The members are all vets of various projects – Spray Paint, Black Eyes, USA/Mexico, more eaze, Thor & Friends, Marriage, Swans, SUR, Astral Spirits Records, among others. Their approach to the form is less front-loaded than most of their peers, and the surface of their sound is sometimes ruffled by aural events of an un-drone-like nature. But the main gush is usually a blend of harmonic tones and textures pointing towards a goal that is just out of ear-shot, just over the next bluff, and perhaps forever just beyond our reach.


Gavial - GER | Exile On Mainstream Records

https://linktr.ee/gavialband

Genre: Fuzzed out Psychedelic Garage Blues

FFO: The Flying Eyes, Pink Floyd, All them Witches, Pontiac, Sleepy Sun


Die Geschichte von GAVIAL beginnt vor fast 15 Jahren als Projekt in Anlehnung an einen Nirvana-Song und aus einem Wortspiel als “Two Red Boys”. Drei Alben als TOURETTE BOYS, zwei Kollaboration mit Tim Holehouse und eine Split-EP mit den Labelkollegen Gaffa Ghandi folgen ebenso wie unzählige Gigs und Touren mit Bands wie Acid Mothers Temple, Dyse, Gaffa Ghandi, The Skull, True Widow oder Sleepy Sun. Die Basis ist eine enge Freundschaft zwischen den Musikern, obwohl sie in verschiedenen Städten leben. Die weitläufigen und unberührten Landschaften zwischen Berlin und Dresden mögen ihren Anteil an der Inspiration für den Sound haben, dessen psychedelische Entrücktheit sich immer wieder in modernem Blues erdet und mehr an den Desert Rock erinnert, den wir aus den Weiten Arizonas kennen als an die urbane Hektik der Großstadt. Flirrende Soundlandschaften, teilweise dunkel und melancholisch, dann wieder hoffnungsvoll von gleißendem Licht und der wohligen, aber trotzdem Unheil verheißenden Hitze der Wüste erfüllt – darin sind GAVIAL wahre Meister.



Gaffa Ghandi - GER | Exile On Mainstream Records

https://gaffaghandi.bandcamp.com/

Genre: Progged out Heavy Stoner Metal

FFO: Rotor, Elder, The Sword, Mastodon, Karma To Burn


Gaffa Ghandi sind ein Phänomen weil sie in kein gängiges Schema passen. Erst einmal bespielen sie das Stoner-Spielfeld und bedienen damit die erwartbaren Kanäle. Doch bald wird klar, dass ihnen das nicht genügt. Also reichern sie das „stonerische Grundkonzept“ mit ordnungsgemäßer Psychedelic an. Und weil sie frech, mutig und pfiffig sind, kommt eine saftige crimsoneske Pfeffermühle über das Ganze. Die Mischung und vor allem die Ambitioniertheit macht verdammt Laune.

events.name: Avery Friedman
events.description:
Avery Friedman is a Brooklyn-based artist (via Cleveland, Ohio) who released her debut album, ‘New Thing‘ via Audio Antihero on April 18th.

Playing her first show in July 2023, she committed herself to playing monthly around New York, going on to record her debut album with collaborators James Chrisman (Sister., h pruz), and Felix Walworth (Told Slant, Florist).

The result was ‘New Thing,’ a sonically deep and layered debut that saw Friedman explore her trauma and queerness with a raw, open-heartedness inspired by artists like Adrianne Lenker, Squirrel Flower, and Babehoven. The album was launched with a sold-out release show at Union Pool, and found support and acclaim from NPR Music (All Songs Considered), The Line of Best Fit, KEXP, BBC, Under the Radar Magazine, No Depression, KLOF Mag, Post-Trash, The Alternative, Atwood Magazine, and many others.

Since the release of ‘New Thing’, Friedman has been recording radio sessions for WNYU and WVKR, and sharing stages with Speedy Ortiz, Matt Quinn (Mt. Joy), Hibou, and Sean Solomon at events promoted by the likes of WFUV and Defector Media.

events.name: Flora Hibberd
events.description:
Like a textile artist, Flora Hibberd weaves layers of meaning into her music. Born in London, she has called Paris home since the age of eighteen. As likely to veer into guitar or synth-driven pop as to take up a 17th century traditional, the songs pulse with surreal allusions and mundane emotions, a tapestry of everyday life shot through with cosmic signs. Hibberd sees her songwriting as a walk in a strangely familiar neighbourhood, revealing and reveling in the oblique and the mystic.  

Her acclaimed debut album Swirl (2025, 22TWENTY) was recorded in Eau Claire, Wisconsin and praised by press internationally, including Le Monde, who hailed it as one of the standout indie-folk releases of the year, and KEXP, who hailed her last release as "a timeless collection of sweeping folk-pop". With her haunting melodies, literary lyricism, and magnetic live presence, Flora Hibberd has quickly established herself as one of the most compelling new voices on the scene.

events.name: Årabrot + Intercourse
events.description:
Kjetil Nernes is a survivor. He is, for all intents and purposes, the Norwegian rock band Årabrot, who formed in Haugesund, Norway in 2001. After stalking the blackened, grimey European noise rock underground for years, a rupturing change came in the form of serious illness in 2014. After contracting a rare and aggressive form of cancer, he nearly died; but the lengthy, painful experience of treatment and recovery gave him the time and space to reconsider his entire life… including his artistic practice.

Speaking from the deconsecrated church in Djura, Sweden, where he lives with his wife, the musician Karin Park and their young daughter, he describes how the illness changed everything: “I struggled out of that period of extreme sickness by writing the last album The Gospel (2016). It was like a big explosion. Because after an explosion you have silence. And in the silence you realise that everything has changed. In that silence, the new record was written.”

After some years The band is up to share their new vibes to the European market.

events.name: Imperial Triumphant + Knoll
events.description:
Atonal black metal titans IMPERIAL TRIUMPHANT return to Berlin!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


Imperial Triumphant - US | Century Media Records

https://imperialtriumphant.bandcamp.com/

FFO: Gorguts, Krallice, Disrythmia, Behold the Arctopus



There’s a murmuring amidst the monoliths of New York City as the sounds of the megalopolis churn below. The city becomes the sound of a human engine that throbs like an atrophying heartbeat; the decaying city of the future in Fritz Lang’s Metropolis. That’s the grandiosity that New Yorkers, IMPERIAL TRIUMPHANT have found equal amounts of beauty and horror within. With their latest release, Goldstar, the masked triumvirate continues their exploration of the urban and arcane. The band has found inspiration in the sound of metal pushed to its darkest extremes, gilded, art deco temples, and looming cityscapes.

Goldstar is IMPERIAL TRIUMPHANT’s most instant and evocative works to date. It bridges the avant-garde and the present in a way they’ve never done before. It’s also the band’s most ambitious album to date, swerving into North African Gnawa music on “Gomorrah Nouveaux”, Brazilian Maracatu on “Pleasuredome”, and an ode to classic NYC architecture on “Lexington Delirium”

events.name: Earthbong + Frost, Pisse & Elend
events.description:
Earthbong is a three-piece doom band from Kiel/Germany. The band was formed in 2018 and released three studio records, a live album and one EP so far. Earthbong are heading towards the riff-filled land with their unique blend of doom, metal and sludge: “They're like a Bongzilla-Sleep-Milkshake. But they get it. They are their own thing." (Mike Scheidt, YOB).

Earthbong has toured Australia in spring 2025, including headlining performances at Sun Burn Festival and Stoned To Death Fest Sydney and shared the stage with the ancestors of the bong metal genre like Bongzilla, Bongripper and Belzebong. They also supported bands such as The Obsessed, Unida and Firebreather. With more than 90 shows over the past years, including festivals like ReykjaDoom Festival (Iceland), Stoned From The Underground (DE), Rock in Bourlon (FR) and Hoflärm Open Air (DE), Earthbong earned a reputation as one of the heaviest and best live acts within the underground doom scene.

Their 4th studio album SALUTATIONS TO THE CULTIVATORS will be released on October 23rd 2026 via The Lasting Dose Records (Vinyl, CD, digital) and Evil Noise Recordings (Cassette), followed by a show at the legendary Høstsabbat Festival in Oslo/Norway. More shows and festivals for 2026/2027 are planned.

events.description: "Heute: Krake!" ist das Debüt Release von KRAKE, frisch und heiß serviert von Noisolution! Das geht gleich richtig rund. Nach zahlreichen Gigs around Berlin und diversen Sommerfestivals, hat sich die Band bereits Rang und Namen erspielt und ist jetzt bereit für den nächsten wichtigen Schritt: der erste Longplayer! Das wird deftig zelebriert - und zwar da, wo schon viele Bands ihre Flügel ausgebreitet haben zum Absprung: NEUE ZUKUNFT am Ostkreuz Berlin. Dafür übernehmen sie für einen Abend den Theatersaal, mit Support von YEAST MACHINE, die ebenfalls auf Noisolution veröffentlicht haben. So ist es fast schon eine kleine Labelnight - im Wohnzimmer der Berliner Stoner Rock Szene. Präsentiert von DUSTOWN.

events.name: Gong
events.description:
Legendary 70s canterbury weirdo prog rock ensemble GONG returns with a new record to Berlin!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


GONG - UK | Kscope

https://www.planetgong.co.uk/

Genre: 70's Canterbury Avantgarde Prog Rock

FFO: Camel, Caravan, Gentle Giant, Genesis


Gong in 2026 features the longest-running line-up of this legendary international psychedelic band.

The universe of Gong was created in 1969 by Daevid Allen, following a profound psychedelic vision. A founder member of Soft Machine, Allen wove his spiritual and metaphysical leanings into an evolving collective, more a mythology than a band in the conventional sense. Gong established itself as one of the most unique, innovative and experimental rock groups of the Seventies, with an experimental mix of rock, jazz, psychedelia and elements of mysticism and surrealism, all laced with a far-out sense of humour.

The current incarnation, who were put together by Daevid for his swansong album with Gong, ‘I See You’, continue to honour his final intent: to take the band “into new unknown heights and depths far beyond anything I could ever imagine myself”. They have composed, recorded and toured together for eleven years since Allen’s passing and they continue to espouse the ethics, attitude and lifestyle that was always at the heart of the band.

This dynamic, powerful and explosive live band continue to tour internationally, including visits to China, USA, Europe, Brazil and Japan. They have released the albums ‘Rejoice! I’m Dead!’ (2016), ‘The Universe Also Collapses’ (2019), ‘Pulsing Signals’ (2021),‘Unending Ascending’ (2023), and now ‘Bright Spirit’ (2026), all on Kscope.

events.name: Grace Cummings
events.description: Grace Cummings kommt im November mit ihrem bislang ambitioniertesten und eindringlichsten Werk nach Europa und Großbritannien. Bloodhorse! – ihr viertes Album, das am 14. August über ATO Records erscheint – markiert einen mutigen Aufbruch in neue musikalische Gefilde. Aufgenommen im kalifornischen Topanga Canyon mit dem Grammy-nominierten Produzenten Jonathan Wilson (Father John Misty, Angel Olsen, Margo Price), zeigt das Album eine Künstlerin, die ihre außergewöhnliche Stimme auf neue Weise einsetzt: jenes tiefe, ungezähmte Alt-Timbre, das einen augenblicklich in seinen Bann zieht. Zwischen Synthesizern, spannungsgeladenen Streicher-Arrangements und schwebenden Grooves entfaltet sich ein Sound, der die intime Wärme ihrer bisherigen Musik bewahrt und zugleich neue, unerwartete Wege einschlägt. Während das letzte Album Ramona noch die Türen zu ihrer Welt öffnete, führt Bloodhorse! direkt in deren dunklere Winkel. Die Songs kreisen um Leben und Tod, Selbstbestimmung und Selbstbefragung. Mal üppig und überwältigend, mal roh und schonungslos, bewegt sich das Album zwischen Verletzlichkeit und Widerstandskraft. Musik, die man nicht nur hört, sondern spürt. Nach einer Europa-Tournee im Vorprogramm von Father John Misty und einer ausverkauften Headline-Show in London bringt Grace Cummings Bloodhorse! im Herbst 2026 gemeinsam mit ihrer fantastischen Band auf die Bühne. Ein Live-Erlebnis, das man sich nicht entgehen lassen sollte.

events.name: Pretty Lightning
events.description:
Germany-based psych-blues duo Pretty Lightning are now on their sixth full-length, have toured around the UK and Europe on numerous occasions and shared stages with the likes of Moon Duo, Clinic, Kikagaku Moyo, Kadavar and Night Beats, among many others. The duo tick off a long list of influences – from 60s psych and delta blues through to experimental rock and drone – and the end product is a throbbing blues psychedelic gloop that collides with the communal vibe of some of their Krautrock forefathers. As often as their sound is indeed full to the brim with crunch, swagger and feedback, Pretty Lightning are also just capable of easing off on that oft-abused accelerator and dealing in something more far hypnotic and drone-like. Fried guitars melt into hazy soundscapes and play angular and repetitive melodies along gritty plodding drums and gooey loops of keys and bells.

With the release of their 2022 LP ‘Dust Moves’, Pretty Lightning began to explore new territory as it´s the band’s first fully instrumental record, offering meandering, cinematic desert blues, strung-out psych-rock and widescreen, hypnotic drones. The follow up album ´Night Wobble´ (2025) pursues this journey, digging even deeper into trippy, instrumental wooziness.

Pretty Lightning will be touring as an instrumental trio in 2026 performing songs exclusively from their last two instrumental outputs.

events.name: Lack + Tonia Reeh + Jacob Bredahl
events.description:
// LACK

Lack veröffentlichen das erste Album seit 18 Jahren und kommen damit auf Tour! In Berlin spielen sie dabei am 27.11. in der neuen Zukunft, zusammen mit Tonia Reeh (Monotekktoni, La Tourette) und Jacob Bredahl.

Fast zwei Jahrzehnte liegen zurück, seit Lack aus Kopenhagen zuletzt neue Musik veröffentlicht haben. Nun veröffentlichen sie ihr erstes Album seit 18 Jahren! Das selbstbetitelte Album erscheint am 11. September beim Label Dream Bureau, und dazu spielt die Band Konzerte in Dänemark, Deutschland und der Tschechischen Republik.

Im Laufe von acht Jahren veröffentlichen Lack drei Alben, spielen unzählige Konzerte in ganz Europa und den Vereinigten Staaten und erwerben sich den Ruf als eine der markantesten und explosivsten Bands Kopenhagens. Sowohl in Dänemark als auch international sind sie als Band, deren Sound mühelos zwischen Post-Hardcore, Indie-Rock und Film Noir wechselt, wahrhaft genreprägend – angetrieben von Thomas Burøs charakteristischem, hohen Gesang, der stets bis an die Grenze des Zusammenbruchs getrieben wird.

2008 dann – kurz nach der Veröffentlichung von „Saturate Every Atom“ – gehen die Bandmitglieder getrennte Wege und legen Lack auf Eis. Seitdem haben die Mitglieder in zahlreichen Bands gespielt, darunter Rising, Tvivler, Total Heels, Anchorless und No Light.

2021 kommen Lack wieder zusammen. Zunächst spielen sie zwei ausverkaufte Konzerte in Dänemark, später folgen weitere Auftritte, darunter etwa 2024 beim größten Metal-Festival Dänemarks, dem Copenhell.

Ohne sich gegenseitig oder irgendwem außerhalb der Band Versprechungen zu machen, beginnen Lack still und leise, neue Musik zu schreiben. Zunächst ist es ein behutsames Auseinandersetzen mit der Frage, ob das Kollektiv auch nach so vielen Jahren noch künstlerische und persönliche Relevanz besitz. Dabei stellt sich heraus, dass die Spannung zwischen menschenfeindlicher Resignation und trotzigem Optimismus, die schon immer das charakteristische Merkmal der Band gewesen ist, noch immer sehr lebendig ist und dass es sich mehr denn je lohnt, darüber zu singen.

Das Ergebnis sind neun Stücke, die Lack live in einem Raum eines alten Bauernhauses auf dem Land in Sjælland aufnehmen. Die Songs drehen sich um die Arbeit als fundamentale Bedingung des Menschseins, und als den grundlegenden Kompromiss, der untrennbar mit dem Aufbau eines sinnvollen Lebens verbunden ist.

Jedes bisherige Lack-Album stellt einen bewussten Bruch mit den Erwartungen dar, die das vorherige Album geweckt hatte. Lack haben noch nie einen Zweck darin gesehen, zu gefallen. Das neue Album bildet keine Ausnahme, baut aber dennoch auf der beachtlichen Fähigkeit der Band auf, einfach immer unverkennbar nach Lack zu klingen.

Die neun Stücke erscheinen am 11. September 2026 als selbstbetiteltes Album beim kleinen Kopenhagener DIY-Label Dream Bureau. Das Album wurde von Jacob Bredahl aufgenommen, von Jakob Reichert Nielsen abgemischt und von Matthew Barnhart gemastert.

www.facebook.com/lackattackdk // www.instagram.com/lackattackdk // www.lackattackdk.bandcamp.com

/// TONIA REEH

Tonia Reeh ist Berliner Indie Underground enfant terrible. Mit einer langen musikalischen Historie von Indie Post Rock bis zu Elektrotrash, Klavierpunk, Revolutionsflamenco und Filmmusik (Masonne, Das Zuckende Vakuum, Jagoda, Monotekktoni, La Tourette, Tonia Reeh). Früher beheimatet auf Labels wie Monika, Sinnbus, Clouds Hill, Solaris Empire. Jetzt wieder DIY und solo unter ihrem bürgerlichen Namen. Diesmal mit stromsparender Akustikgitarre und Stimme.

Tonia Reeh spielt Songs vom aktuellen Album „Blues Babies“ und andere eigene Schmachtfetzen: Kleine auf den Punkt gebrachte Geschichten, feministisch, anarchistisch, traurig, poetisch und anmassend frech. Immer auf der Seite der Krummen, der Ausgebeuteten: Frauen, Nashörnern, Kindern, Oktaedern, Obdachlosen, Migrantinnen, Gitarren, Losern und Prostituierten.

„You better keep your tongue inside your mouth!“
„I´m sure you don`t want to support the war lords.“

// BIOs //

THE DARTS (US), now based in Seattle, Washington, formed in 2016 with the goal of making great all-grrl garage-rock, seeing the world, and having a fab slumber party every night. The four women threw on vintage black slips, kicked off their shoes, and set out on the adventure.

https://thedartsus.bandcamp.com/album/halloween-love-songs
https://youtu.be/itmm1CMg_yQ
https://youtu.be/HkaR_wz7nmw

In the first year, the band put out two self-produced EPs and signed with Dirty Water Records (UK), which then released the first full-length vinyl, Me.Ow (2017). Dirty Water then re-released the first two EPs as a second full-length vinyl, The Darts (2017). The band immediately went on tour with The Living End and Billie Joe Armstrong’s The Longshot, and soon found themselves on big European stages like Sjockfest, Cosmic Trip, and Roots nRoses.

In 2018, Jello Biafra signed The Darts to his label, Alternative Tentacles, and released their first 7-inch, Bullet (2018) and the third full-length record, I Like You But Not Like That (2018). The band toured the US supporting The Damned, performed on main stages at big festivals like Punk Rock Bowling, Hipnosis Fest and The Bash, and got placements on top tv shows like Peaky Blinders and reviews in Rolling Stone. During the pandemic, Vox Guitars hosted a Darts’ Instagram Live session garnering over fifty thousand viewers. In 2022, The Darts released the EP Love Tsunami on Adrenalin Fix Music (FR), toured it around the US and Europe, and performed a studio session on legendary KEXP.

In 2023, Alternative Tentacles released The Darts’ fourth LP, Snake Oil, funded entirely by fans and co-produced by Jello Biafra himself. The band went on a 100-day European tour, with unique European editions of Snake Oil and many sold-out shows, plus appearances at top festivals Munster Raving Looney Party (Spain), Relache Fest (France), Festival Beat (Italy), Loungefest (Holland), and Muehlen Madness (Germany). The first pressings of Snake Oil sold out in both the US and Europe in less than two months and second pressings were rushed out on both continents during the tour.

While juggling the Snake Oil tour, the band recorded their fifth full-length record, Boomerang, with Grammy-winning producer Mark Rains (Hoover iii, Death Valley Girls) at Station House Studio in Los Angeles. Once again the album was released by Alternative Tentacles on different US and EU editions in March 2024 and the release was again followed by over four months of touring in Europe, UK, and USA. The album catapulted the band into feature articles in Rock n Folk, Rolling Stone, and many other major publications, plus appearances on France 24 television, BBC radio, a heavily-publicized live show inside

Barlinnie Prison for the prisoners in Edinburgh, and inclusion on many best of 2024 lists. During the massive tour, the band stopped to record two new singles in France, which were then released exclusively on a compilation of sold-out-on-vinyl essential tracks, Nightmare Queens (2025 Adrenalin Fix Music). The compilation album continuously sold out and had to be repressed three times in ninety days.

In 2025, with a new lineup of singer/founder Nicole Laurenne (lead vocals, organ), Lindsay Scarey (bass, backup vocals), Rebecca Davidson (guitar), and original Darts drummer Rikki Watson (drums, backup vocals), the band toured the entire USA alongside Dion Lunadon and SERVICE and again invaded Europe for several months, performing on the main stage at huge international festivals: Binic Folk & Blues Fest, BearStone Fest, Relache Fest, Boneyard Weekender, Rocketmen Fest, CornRock Fest, Dollfest, Gonerfest, and Tough Enough Fest.

The band returned to the studio at Station House in Los Angeles and recorded the latest full-length LP, Halloween Love Songs (2026 Adrenalin Fix Music / Meow Hiss Music). Nicole wrote the album with the intention of side A being spooky-fun Halloween kitsch for trick-or-treating as the sun sets, and the darker sound of side B rocking the after-midnight bonfire with the leftover candy. With art by Travis Knight, the album was released in both the USA and Europe on March 3, 2026. Lead track “Midnight Creep” (written by Laurenne and Scarey) is featured in a video by Frogman director Anthony Cousins, and “Apocalypse” - with Davidson and Scarey performing it - were featured in a recent Gretsch Guitars advertisement. A huge album release tour is planned for the USA, Europe, UK, and Japan, that will encompass most of 2026.

events.name: Las Eras
events.description:
Entre Trópicos presents:

Hailing from Buenos Aires, Las Eras have established themselves as one of the most compelling voices in contemporary Spanish-language post-punk. Their sound blends electronic textures, darkwave atmospheres, and irresistible dancefloor energy into a style that is both hypnotic and highly addictive.

Often compared to acts such as Boy Harsher, while also echoing the pioneering spirit of Spanish electronic groups like Aviador Dro and Ciudad Lineal, Las Eras have built a distinctive identity that resonates far beyond Argentina’s underground scene.

The band arrives in Berlin as part of the tour for their latest album, Caída del Velo, a record that further expands their fusion of melancholic melodies, driving rhythms, and electronic experimentation.

For fans of post-punk, darkwave, synth-pop, and alternative electronic music, Las Eras offer a live experience that is intense, immersive, and impossible to stand still to.

events.name: Lost in Kyiv
events.description:
Lost in Kyiv returns in 2026 with We’re All Going to Be Fine (Pelagic Records, June 19th), marking both the band’s fifth album and a symbolic new chapter as the French quartet officially changes its name from Lost in Kiev to Lost in Kyiv.

Driven by the energy of a renewed line-up, the band embraces a heavier, sharper and more modern sound — rawer and more direct than ever before. Moving away from the systemic themes explored on previous records, We’re All Going to Be Fine turns inward, diving into the fragile tension between hope and collapse, and the growing disconnection of modern life from ourselves and each other.

Blending their cinematic post-rock roots with abrasive guitars, post-metal intensity and crushing emotional dynamics, Lost in Kyiv no longer observes the world from a distance — they confront it head-on.

Daran hat sich bisher nichts geändert. Wird weiterhin ständig falsch ausgesprochen.
Dabei ist das doch nur das niederländische Wort für „alle“. Easy, oder?
Im letzten Jahr hat sich der Bandname jedenfalls schon durch so manche Festivalmoderation und Kneipenrunde gestottert – bei über 60 Konzerten zum selbstbetitelten Debütalbum auch kein Wunder. Die beiden unzertrennlichen Kölner sagen: Weitermachen. Deshalb geht’s im Winter wieder auf Achse mit insgesamt 13 Stops. Neue Songs?

events.name: 30,000 Monkies
events.description:
Belgian champagne metal roughnecks 30,000 Monkies return with new album to Berlin!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


30,000 Monkies - BE | FVN KVLT Rekords

https://30000monkies.bandcamp.com/

Genre: Champagne Metal

FFO: Sumac, Thou, Melvins


Born out of the Belgian noise-rock scene, 30,000 Monkies have mutated into a far heavier beast. Having refined their finger-chomping recipe with pinches of tectonic sludge, mathy weirdness, and blackened fun, these Beringen boys have been starrrrrrrring in action-packed spectacles across European stages. The formula is simple: if crushing riffs and volume put a stupid grin on your face, this may be exactly the dish for you.

Heavy music is a happy place, and through a colorful painbow of image and sound, 30,000 Monkies share a message of hope and gleeful brutality. Their joyously anthemic and brutally honest – but well-meant – punch in the feels sticks out like a stockbroker in corpse paint. And once the noise clears? Your ears still ring loud and clear: 30,000 Monkies are forever, and champagnemetal is here to stay.

events.name: Takeshi's Cashew
events.description:
Das Wiener Kollektiv TAKESHI’S CASHEW präsentiert am 30.10.2026 ihr neues Album „Planet Odyssey 64“. Nach weltweiten Tourneen mit ihren ersten beiden Alben gönnte sich die Band eine kreative Pause und kehrt nun mit neuem Sound zurück.

Der bisherige analoge Cosmofunk der Band wurde um Electro-Einflüsse erweitert. Die sechs Musiker experimentierten mit alten Synthesizern, ließen sich von Vintage-Computerspiel-Themen inspirieren und schufen so ein neuartiges Klanguniversum. Ihre besondere Spielfreude brachte die Idee für eine Art Konzeptalbum namens „Planet Odyssey 64“ hervor. Begleiten Sie uns auf eienr Reise mit dieser außergewöhnlichen und ziemlich einzigartigen Gruppe.

events.name: Lemongrab + CV Vision + Blitzer
events.description:
Lemongrab and MILK ME present.

𝙇𝙚𝙢𝙤𝙣𝙜𝙧𝙖𝙗, 𝘾𝙑 𝙑𝙞𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣 & 𝘽𝙡𝙞𝙩𝙯𝙚𝙧,
𝘈𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳 𝘒𝘪𝘯𝘥 𝘰𝘧 𝘍𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘥𝘰𝘮 EP Release show, 09.12.2026 at Neue Zukunft, Berlin

𝙇𝙚𝙢𝙤𝙣𝙜𝙧𝙖𝙗
Lemongrab (Berlin, DE) is a garage punk 4-piece known for their raw, cathartic live shows and art punk-fuelled studio efforts. Their influences travel from The Stooges’ proto-punk shenanigans all the way to The Clean’s jangly earworms, taking scenic detours for Pylon’s weirdo pop hooks on their way to Bikini Kill’s riot-friendly neighbourhood.

The group first introduced their patented brand of punk-tinged garage rock by way of elapsed-play, The Ones with the Brooms (2016), and debut full-length, It Doesn’t Sound Good but It Feels Awesome (2019) before relocating from Montréal, QC to Berlin, DE in 2020. Then came The Wet Album (2021), a 6-song essay further embracing their punk ethos, and sophomore full-length I Spy with My Little Eye (2024) via niche tastemakers U-Bac Records. Catch Lemongrab as they unleash songs from Another Kind of Freedom (September 11th, 2026 via Mothland & kChrüsïmüsï Records) in an alternative music lair near you!

𝘾𝙑 𝙑𝙞𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣
CV Vision returns with the follow-up to his last opus “Im Tal der Stutzer” and delivers his sixth studio album “Release The Beast” – where he finds the sweet spot between psych rock, Detroit techno, fried synths, black metal and library music. “I wanted to get a rougher sound on this record,” he says. “I dug out my two broken reel-to-reel tape machines, and patched them together, like Frankenstein. That’s what gels everything really - there’s different musical styles, but it’s the tape machine that brings it all together, sound-wise.”

𝘽𝙡𝙞𝙩𝙯𝙚𝙧
Blitzer are an international trio based in Berlin,
Playing between the lines of New Wave and Garage Punk their sound comes from the likes of Parquet Quarts and Suburban Lawns.

We have released thirty early-bird tickets for 10 euros + ticketing fees for people who are currently financially struggling.

events.name: The Wolfgang Press + A Southern Code
events.description:
Pioneering post-punk band and former 4AD recording artists The Wolfgang Press return to play live in Berlin for the first time in 31 years, continuing their 21st-century revival, which started two years ago.

Their new album, Asylum Variations, is due September 25th on Downwards Records, following 2024’s A 2nd Shape – their first album in almost three decades.

The band will perform in their new incarnation, with founding members Michael Allen and Andrew Gray joined by Gray’s brother Stephen Gray, who replaces original keyboardist Mark Cox.

Sharing this special double-headliner gig are Downwards labelmates A Southern Code, who also have a forthcoming album, slated for October 2026.

Formerly known as EROS, this international experimental project, which made a splash at the 2023 edition of the Berlin Atonal festival, features Downwards owner Karl O’Connor (Regis), Liam Andrews (My Disco) and Boris Wilsdorf, who is Einstürzende Neubauten’s longtime sound engineer and the owner of the andereBaustelle recording studio in Berlin.

Two distinct fusions of post-punk and experimental electronic music come together for one exceptional evening at Neue Zukunft, one of Berlin’s newest and most distinctive indie clubs, renowned for its clear and powerful sound.

events.name: Kino Motel + Fee Aviv
events.description:
Join KINO MOTEL as they celebrate the release of their sophomore album 'SYMBOLISM' in Berlin. With special guest FEE AVIV.

Kino Motel are excited to release their sophomore album Symbolism in Berlin on December 10 2026. With very special guest Fee Aviv.

Symbolism introduces Kino Motel’s next era with brooding, cinematic flair. The album is sunlit but uneasy, romantic but frayed, cinematic but scrappy. If Kino Motel's debut album Visions introduced their world then Symbolism sets to deepen it, not as a strict concept record but as a collection of moments that gain power in accumulation. Each song stands on its own, but together they create a set of signs, fragments, and emotional codes.

With special guest Fee Aviv. Born in Berlin, raised in the theatre: Fee Aviv is an artist through and through. Since 2019, Fee Aviv has been releasing her own songs: delicate, minimalist compositions meet dark synths and big pop gestures that provide the perfect setting for her unique, velvety, deep, and dark voice, telling of queer desire, empowerment, fears, and growing up.

Kino Motel Symbolism is out October 23 on Beast Records (EU) & La Nef D Fous (EU). The band are touring in support of the album release throughout Europe in November 2026.

Join us to celebrate Symbolism's release in Berlin on December 10 2026 at Neue Zukunft Garage. Tickets are 12€ for pre-sale, or 15€ on the door.

events.name: Die Wilde Jagd + Love-Songs
events.description:
Founded by producer and composer Sebastian Lee Philipp, Die Wilde Jagd stands as one of the most distinctive projects emerging from Germany’s contemporary experimental and psychedelic music landscape. Moving fluidly between avant-pop, electronic composition, and kraut-inspired minimalism, the project creates sound worlds filled with drama, mysticism, and ecstasy. Praised internationally for their singular German lyricism, Die Wilde Jagd has toured extensively across more than 20 countries.

For this special Berlin performance, Die Wilde Jagd returns to the stage in a stripped-back duo configuration featuring Sebastian Lee Philipp and Manuel Chittka. Focusing exclusively on material from the project’s landmark first two albums - Die Wilde Jagd (2015) and Uhrwald Orange (2018) - the duo revisits the hypnotic pulse and dark, driving intensity that shaped their early identity. Reduced to its raw essentials, this uncompromising live format transforms fan favorites like “2000 Elefanten”, “Wah Wah Wallenstein”, and “Jagd auf den Hirsch” into an ecstatic, high-energy concert experience not to be missed.

For many years, the Hamburg-based trio consisting of Thomas Korf , Sebastian Kokus, and Manuel Chittka has been refining their sound, weaving elements of krautrock, dub, new wave, jazz, and cosmic music into a unique Love-Songs amalgam.

To date, they have released three albums on labels such as Bureau B and Phase Group, as well as various EPs.

events.description:

Drawing inspiration from the psychedelic alternative scene of the late 60s and 70s, as well as the heavy metal and doom of the 80s and 90s, Kant creates a unique sound that blends distorted guitars, pounding drums, and swirling melodies with haunting vocals and experimental noise.“ - Adrian Bang (ZUKUNFT)

events.name: Roomer
events.description:
Berlin-based trio Roomer weave noise, melody, and memory into expansive guitar-driven songs. Formed by long-time friends and collaborators Ronja Schößler, Ludwig Wandinger, and Luka Aron, the band brings together distinct voices from across Europe’s avant-garde, folk, and electronic scenes, folding these lineages into a sound that moves between shoegaze density, diaristic songwriting, and sonic exploration. Their music often holds opposites in suspension: clarity and blur, structure and drift, intimacy and collapse.

Their debut album Leaving It All to Chance (2025, Squama) introduced this language in full, pairing emotionally direct songs with shifting textures and dense layers of distortion. With Staircase Made of Rope, their second album for Squama, out September 18, 2026, Roomer widen the frame further. Built largely from improvisations and first takes, the record embraces instability as method, moving between density and silence while allowing melodies to surface and dissolve in unexpected ways.

Following appearances at London’s ICA, ESNS, and The Great Escape, Roomer return with new music and will tour extensively across Europe in fall 2026.

events.name: Nina Winder-Lind + Lily Beltane
events.description:
Einlass: 19:00 // Beginn: 20:00

Support: Lily Beltane

Bekannt als Sängerin und Cellistin der gefeierten Brighton-Band The New Eves, verbindet die schwedische Musikerin, Nina Winder-Lind, auf ihrem ersten Soloalbum rohe Rock-‘n’-Roll-Energie mit poetischer Intimität und kompromissloser Emotionalität. Ihre Songs erzählen von Liebe, Freiheit, weiblicher Selbstbestimmung und einer tiefen Verbundenheit zur Natur – getragen von einer ausdrucksstarken Stimme und gitarrengetriebenen Arrangements. Musikalisch bewegt sich Winder-Lind zwischen Folk, Garage Rock und Art Rock und beruft sich dabei auf Einflüsse wie Patti Smith, Nina Simone oder Lou Reed. Entstanden ist ein ebenso kraftvolles wie verletzliches Album voller Intensität, das die befreiende Kraft von Musik feiert. Mit Wild Love etabliert sich Nina Winder-Lind als eine der spannendsten neuen SongwriterInnen Großbritanniens.

events.name: Ulrika Spacek
events.description:
Auch wenn die fünf Mitglieder von Ulrika Spacek jeweils ihren eigenen Weg gegangen sind, war die Band stets ein Sinnbild für kollektive Kunst. Trotz ihrer unterschiedlichen Hauptberufe (Experimentalphysiker, Grafikdesigner, Musikproduzenten) zeigt sich dieses gemeinsame Streben in der geteilten Traumlogik ihrer Musik: In den ungewöhnlichen Melodien, den schroff kantigen Gitarrenklängen und zirrenden, wolkenhaften Klangatmosphären. Es zeigt sich in all dem, was zwischen ihnen gesagt und nicht gesagt wird; im gemeinsamen Schreiben, Produzieren und Abmischen ihrer Stücke. Und auch wenn sich jeder einzelne Teil von ihnen auf eine gemeinsame Vision zubewegt, ist das Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit nirgendwo so deutlich zu spüren wie im Gesamtbild, zu dem Ulrika Spacek gehören.

Das neueste Album der Gruppe, EXPO, ist eine Dialektik zwischen Analogem und Elektronischem. Obwohl ihre Wurzeln in der Art-Rock-Welt liegen – und obwohl sie mehr denn je von elektronischen Elementen inspiriert sind – interessieren sich Ulrika Spacek für die Diskrepanz zwischen beiden Genres. Ihre Musik beschäftigt sich mit menschlicher Wärme und digitaler Isolation, ist gleichermaßen einladend wie befremdlich. In vielerlei Hinsicht drückt die Band die Spannung aus, die das moderne Leben prägt. “Our music has always been a collage – a bit patchwork, sonically – but what makes this album a landmark for us is that we went one step further and made our own sound bank and essentially sampled ourselves,” sagt die Band. Sie erschaffen ihre eigenen Doppelgänger in einer fast realen Welt, in der die Band wie in einem Spiegelsaal erscheint. Digitale Drums werden gesampelt und über echte Drums gelegt, der Effekt ist fast wie eine umgekehrte Geburt – aus dem Äther gezogen und zurück in die greifbare Welt gebracht.

events.name: Sparta
events.description:
SPARTA is a post-hardcore band led by Jim Ward, formerly of At The Drive-In, with a career spanning over 30 years. Formed in the early 2000s, they released three albums—Wiretap Scars (2002), Porcelain (2004), and Threes (2006)—before hiatuses delayed later records: Trust The River (2020) and a self-titled album (2022). Ward has also worked on solo material and side projects like Sleepercar. Their sixth album, Cut A Silhouette, was inspired by a phrase about leaving a lasting impression. Recorded in just seven days with producer J. Robbins, it reflects a return to a raw, collaborative process with current members Matt Miller and Neil Hennessey. The album blends past and present, featuring contributions from collaborators like Frank Iero and Kemble Walters, but remains rooted in Sparta’s core sound. The record represents a renewed sense of purpose after years of doubt, industry shifts, and post-pandemic struggles. Rather than relying on nostalgia, Sparta aims to evolve while maintaining their identity, with Cut A Silhouette marking both a creative reset and continuation of their legacy.

Emerging from the Norwegian hardcore scene, HAMMOK is quickly becoming one of the most anticipated bands from the north. They had a immediate breakthrough at ESNS 2023 with a legendary concert at VERA who shocked the audience, and crowned “the second best show at ESNS 2023” according to 3voor12, followed up with crazy moshpits at Best Kept Secret, Arctangent, Core Fest, Indiestadt/Paradiso and many more festivals summer 2023. In 2024 Hammok traveled through Europe and Britain and banked a huge festival run with their groundbreaking debut album “look how long lasting everything is moving forward for once”. The noisy power-trio is pushing genres left and right which means you should be ready for anything. J/D/F forever long lasting.

events.name: Skraeckoedlan
events.description:
Skraeckoedlan is a band that writes sci-fi books, creates video games, arcade machines and all encompassing concepts and universes. They also write music. Heavy fuzz-rock to be precise. With melodic swedish lyrics that sing about metaphorical sci-fi stories and paint dreamlike creatures on cosmic canvases. 

Two things are ever present in all the adventures the band embarks on. The first thing is the total nerd factor of it all. They are delightfully and manically detail oriented in everything they do. Questions like “What is the LORE of this riff?” are neither uncommon nor unreasonable for them. This is at its utmost, rooted in the band's love and veneration for the creative process.

The second thing follows logically from the first thing, as things usually do. Though not always. To keep the nerd factor as close to galactic maximum as possible Skraeckoedlan has developed a ruthless DIY-attitude. Since their start in 2009 the cooks in the kitchen have become fewer and fewer and the band prefers to cook its own soup with as little interference as possible. Case and point, their latest album, The Vermillion Sky, was recorded, produced and mixed by the band. An ambitious undertaking that started with the humble google search “How do you mic a snare drum?”. 

The albums which have led to today's creative autonomy are three. 

2011 Äppelträdet: The band's debut album is released. Produced by Oscar Cedermalm from the band Truckfighters

2015 Sagor: The bands second release saw the band producing all of the music together with friends while the vocals were partially produced by Daniel Bergstrand (Meshuggah, In Flames). 

2019 Earth: It’s award season! Their third album was nominated for P3 Guld (Swedish public broadcast award) as well as album of the year from Manifestgalan, a Swedish independent music award. The album was produced together with Erik Berglund (Brothers of metal, Gaupa, Good Harvest) and reached number one in vinyl sales in Sweden. 

In between albums the band has released a number of singles including a cover of the Swedish band Kent's song Pärlor which reached number one on Spotify's Viral 50 Sweden. 

Records are one thing, but Skraeckoedlan are and have always been a band to see live. Since their inception the band have used their DIY sensibilities to book and arrange their own shows together with others in the Swedish underground music scene. Over the years some 500 shows have been played throughout Sweden and Europe. From sweaty basement floors to large club and festival stages such as Peace and Love, Sweden Rock, Stoned from the Underground, Borgholm Brinner and Desertfest. They’ve shared the stage with iconic bands such as Dozer, Red Fang, Fu Manchu, Orange Goblin, Kylesa, Opeth, In Flames, Witchcraft, Graveyard, Truckfighters and Danko Jones to name a few.

To continuously grow in their creative process something Skraeckoedlan try to do with every album release, Their latest album was accompanied by a scifi book, comic book, computer game and an arcade machine so the heights the band will need to climb to on their next release are pretty up there. One thing is for sure however, the view from the top will be spectacular.

Complimented and grounded by a full guns blazing, thunderous and unrelenting rhythm section made up of drummer Joose (Petyr, Warish, Harsh Toke, Pharlee) and bassist Quinn-George Camacho (Child, Babylon), their wild live performances are nothing short of a full body experience.

events.name: Dazzling Killmen + Prophet & Flesh
events.description:
Foundational math rock / post-metal / jazz-core band Dazzling Killmen have announced their reformation and a return to live performances. Founding members Nick Sakes (vocals, guitar) and Blake Fleming (drums, later of The Mars Volta) will perform together for the first time in 30 years, joined by bassist Evan Jagels and guitarist Ben Greenberg of Uniform.

Formed in the St. Louis area in 1990, Dazzling Killmen originally consisted of vocalist/guitarist Nick Sakes alongside jazz students Blake Fleming and bassist Darin Gray. The band released four singles, a live cassette and two full-length albums before officially disbanding in 1995, with most of their catalog released on the influential independent label SKiN GRAFT Records.

Drawing equally from hardcore punk and jazz, Dazzling Killmen have long been cited by critics and peers as a key influence on the development of math rock and post-metal.

Support: Prophet & Flesh

Germany’s Prophet & Flesh fuse heavy metal, hardcore punk and filthy rock ’n’ roll into a sound that is both melodic and crushing. Drawing on everything from Darkthrone, Poison Idea and Entombed to Thin Lizzy and gothic rock, the band deliver sharp riffs, real weight and plenty of unexpected twists.

events.name: Elephant9
events.description:
Norways most exciting avantgarde fusion jazz powertrio is back!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


Elephant9 - NOR | Rune Grammofon

https://elephant9band.bandcamp.com/
Genre: Experimental Prog Fusion Powertrio
For Fans Of: Mahavishnu Orchestra, Motorpsycho, Jaga Jazzist, ELP


E9 are:

Stale Storløkken (Supersilent, worked with Motorpsycho, Krokofant etc.)

Torstein Lofthus (ex-SHINING, Member of Mathias Eick Quintet, etc.)

Nikolai Hængsle (Big Bang, Møster, Needlepoint, etc.)


Elephant9 (established 2006 in Oslo, Norway) is a Norwegian progressive/neo-psychedelic/jazz-rock trio which formed in 2006 under the name Storløkken/Eilertsen/Lofthus, for the members of the band, namely Ståle Storløkken (keyboard), Nikolai Eilertsen (bass) and Torstein Lofthus (drums).

The members of the group have a strong history in bands like Bigbang, Shining, Motorpsycho and Supersilent, but it’s within the constellation Elephant9 that these three musicians have been given the ultimate playground to showcase their eclectic tastes and musical abilities.

Through Torstein Lofthus’ thunderous and hazardous drumming, bass player Nikolai Hængsle’s steady, thumping timekeeping, keyboardist and organ player Ståle Storløkken’s rich and uncompromising layers– they give you sounds and rhythm structures that have made grown men and women cry and laugh in joy. Elephant9 find inspiration in music that pushes the envelope, which has made music journalists dig deep for fitting descriptions. The circular melodic themes of Tangerine Dream have been mentioned, so has the blazing, phasing world of Jimi Hendrix. Other reviewers have namedropped John Coltrane, Deep Purple, Soft Machine, King Crimson and Fela Kuti – all artists who have in common that they disregarded the rules and have stood the test of time because of that. Still, Elephant9 feel no desire in being regarded as “retro”, as they venture into a new chaotic time for music - where technology seems to have made people abandon tired descriptions and references – with open arms.

events.name: Liars
events.description: Liars is the compositional project of Australian composer, producer and performer Angus Andrew. Since 1999, Liars has become one of contemporary music's most singular and continually evolving voices, with each release establishing its own distinct sonic and conceptual language. Across more than two decades, Andrew has developed Liars as a vehicle for exploring composition, field recording, improvisation and experimental studio practice, creating a body of work that continually reimagines the possibilities of song, structure and sound. Presented live by Angus Andrew with an ensemble of collaborators, Liars combines immersive sound, physical performance and an uncompromising commitment to musical reinvention, creating performances that are as unpredictable as they are emotionally direct.

events.description: Spirit Mother is a heavy rock band, originating in Long Beach, CA and now based in rural PNW Burns, Oregon.  Their sound is anthologized through a folk-informed and classical lens.  Their dynamic and imposing wall of sound, coupled with a driving backbeat, grips through atmospheric strings and haunting vocals.

Buenos Vampiros are a post-punk quartet from Mar del Plata, Argentina — dark atmospheres, gothic sensibility and an undeniable pop instinct. events.name: SEK Record Release + SOWA + Knight Fish
events.description:
SEK return with their new album "Wallensteins Garage"!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


SEK [Stoyan/Edert/Kazzer] - Berlin | Exile on Mainstream Records

(Members of Elder, Gavial, Gaffa Ghandi)

stoyanedertkazzer.bandcamp.com/

Genre: Historian Oriented Rock / Psychedelic Prog Stoner Rock

FFO: Pink Floyd, Motorpsycho, Electric Moon, Hawkwind


For four years, SEK have been simmering beneath the surface of Berlin’s underground music scene. After two DIY cassette releases, the trio now breaks through with Wallenstein’s Garage, their first album on vinyl – a debut that is equal parts concept album, historical meditation, and expansive psychedelic rock journey.

The album draws its inspiration from the Thirty Years’ War (1618–1648), one of Europe’s most devastating conflicts. Fought largely across the territories of present-day Germany, the war began as a religious conflict between Protestant and Catholic states before evolving into a prolonged political struggle involving most of Europe’s major powers. It left vast regions depopulated and reshaped the political landscape of the continent, making it one of the defining events of early modern European history.

At the center of Wallenstein’s Garage stands Albrecht Wenzel Eusebius von Wallenstein (1583–1634), the Bohemian military commander who became one of the war’s most influential and controversial figures. Several songs revolve around the Battle of Lützen in 1632 – one of the conflict’s most famous engagements, remembered both for its enormous human cost and for the death of Swedish King Gustavus Adolphus. Yet SEK are not interested in historical reenactment. Instead, they construct a fictional frame: Wallenstein sits alone in his garage, restoring his taxidermied war horse, Amore Mio, while reflecting on the battle and the choices that shaped his life.

From this deliberately absurd and surreal premise emerges a meditation on memory, mythmaking, and historiography. Why do societies commemorate wars and battles? At what point does history become fiction – and fiction become another way of understanding history? What is remembered, what disappears, and how can music capture the fragile boundary between the two?

The band’s musical vocabulary is as expansive as its subject matter. Fuzz-drenched guitars soaked in swirling delay collide with galloping bass lines, driving drums, and dreamlike synthesizers. Moments of hypnotic groove give way to passages of near-total chaos, where rhythm and harmony dissolve like military formations collapsing in close combat. Elsewhere, delicate mandolin melodies emerge before unfolding into slow, grief-stricken soundscapes inspired by doom and drone metal. Moving effortlessly between improvisation, cinematic atmosphere, and crushing heaviness, SEK create music that does not simply revisit history – it invites listeners to inhabit it.

The record will be released on Exile On Mainstream on black vinyl, bundled with a CD and digitally.

events.name: Bleib Modern + Konstantin Unwohl
events.description:
BLEIB MODERN geht neue Wege. Erstmals in der Bandgeschichte gibt es deutsche Texte. Neben Gitarren, Bass und Schlagzeug sind nun auch Synths und Samples integraler Bestandteil. Die abwechslungsreichen Songstrukturen führen uns in eine funkelnde Traumwelt: Mit Stücken wie „T.W.T.I.A.” und „Feeling Great” sind treibende Ohrwürmer dabei, die sicher schnell zu Fan-Favoriten werden, „Stell Dir Vor” und Rainy Day” hingegen sind der perfekte Soundtrack für dunklere Momente. Die Musik hat den essentiellen Bleib Modern Vibe, aber auf der nächsten Ebene.Eingerahmt werden die neun neuen Lieder von einem Intro und einem Outro, was dem ganzen Album einen konzeptionellen Charakter verleiht und auch die experimentellere Seite von BLEIB MODERN zeigt. Keine Frage, mit diesem Album liefern BLEIB MODERN ihren bisherigen künstlerischen Höhepunkt ab und werden schnell eine Erfolgs-Stufe erreichen, auf der derzeit nur Bands wie Lebanon Hanover oder She Past Away stehen.

Der Hamburger Musiker KONSTANTIN UNWOHL, bekannt geworden durch den Underground Hit „Mein Verstand” und das auf dem Debüt vertretene „Amarillo”, wagt auf seinem neuen Album den Sprung in noch getriebenere Gewässer. Wo kurzweilige Befriedigung im ewigen Kampf mit nagenden Zweifeln den Alltag begleiten, wo die Sonne spottend auf das gesenkte Haupt scheint und wo der letzte Drink immer einer zu viel ist - dort bewegt sich der neue Unwohl auf „Neuer Wall” und überzeugt mit kraftvollen, aber unvorhersehbaren Drummachine-Rhythmen, Genrevermischungen im Stil der frühen Yello Alben und der skeptischen Positionierung des Sängers gegenüber einer immer extremer werdenden Außen- und Innenwelt und vereint so sowohl nostalgische Momente, als auch einen modernen Zeitgeist.

events.name: Im Anschlusz: Constant Disappointment + Dosenstolz (feat. Tancred) + Mangel
events.description:
IM ANSCHLUSS meldet sich mit einem wilden Mix aus düsterem D-Beat, Grunge und wildem und überdrehtem Deutschpunk/Queerpunk aus der Sommerpause zurück.

MANGEL aus Berlin präsentieren D-Beat mit politischen deutschen Texten („Widerstand muss sich wieder lohnen“). Die Songs liegen unter zwei Minuten und betonen die eher düsteren Seiten des Lebens: Nazis, Bullen, Depressionen.

CONSTANT DISAPPOINTMENT kommen aus Dresden und sind Freund*innen von Dosenstolz. „Erwartet nichts und werdet trotzdem enttäuscht“, behaupten sie, so schlimm ist es aber nicht. Grunge meets Indie mit nachdenklichen, englischen Texten.

Die umtriebigen DOSENSTOLZ, ebenfalls aus Dresden, machen mit ihrem unterhaltsamen Deutschpunk/Queerpunk so manchen CSD unsicher („Weder straight noch edge sondern queer und angetrunken“) und sind nun endlich auch bei Im Anschluss zu Gast. Wer bei Songs wie Arbeitszeitbetrug, Heten Treten (mir beim Pogo auf den Fuß) und natürlich den grandiosen Hits „Nie wieder Arbeit“ und „Gesellschaftskritik“ nicht pogt, ist selber schuld. Als wär das nicht genug, bringen sie diesmal als Special Guest den Antifa-Rapper TANCRED mit.

events.name: Mondo Drag + Early Moods
events.description:
Fast acht Jahre nach dem letzten Album kehrt Mondo Drag mit Through the Hourglass zurück. Die Zeit dazwischen war geprägt von persönlichen Verlusten, der Pandemie und einer längeren Bandpause. Sänger und Keyboarder John Gamiño verarbeitet auf dem Album Trauer, Vergänglichkeit und das Gefühl, dass die Zeit unaufhaltsam verstreicht.

Mit den neuen Mitgliedern Conor Riley (Bass) und Jimmy Perez (Schlagzeug) fand die Band neue Energie. Die Songs blicken auf Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft und verbinden persönliche Erfahrungen mit psychedelischen und progressiven Klängen.

Stücke wie „Burning Daylight“ thematisieren Hilflosigkeit angesichts der kalifornischen Waldbrände, während „Death in Spring“ Freunden gewidmet ist, die durch Gewalt, Sucht und psychische Erkrankungen ums Leben kamen. Insgesamt ist das Album deutlich persönlicher als frühere Veröffentlichungen.

Der Titel Through the Hourglass verweist auf die Fernsehserie Days of Our Lives und erinnert zugleich an Gamiños verstorbene Mutter. Nach Jahren der Stagnation sieht die Band das Album als Neubeginn und Auftakt zu einem neuen Kapitel ihrer Entwicklung.

events.name: Fangus
events.description:
"There is something wonderfully disorienting about a band that feels less like a modern project and more like a strange artefact that has simply surfaced in the present day." - Out of Rage Magazine

"A classic 70s hard rock album that perfectly captures the essence of the genre." - Visions Magazin

"Fangus transport not only themselves but also the listener to another forbidden dimension told through the power of music." - Outlaws of the Sun

Their forthcoming debut album, Emerald Dream drifts through a realm shaped by fractured memories, ancient myths resurfacing in the unconscious, and visions stirred by the intoxicating pull of psychoactive plants. It is an album born where the borders of waking life blur, revealing something older, stranger, and quietly alive beneath the surface.Drawing deeply from the raw pulse of early 70's heavy rock and the primal weight of proto metal, the record pushes Fangus further into their own mythic territory. Fueled by hard prog turns, hypnotic synths lines, and a theatrical sense of occult menace, Emerald Dream expands the band’s universe into wilder, more enchanted dimensions. It is both a pilgrimage and a nightmare, and an initiation into a green labyrinth where the roots remember everything.

Magically spawned from the underworld in MMXXII, Fangus is steadily drawing believers into their surrealist world through performances that are as unsettling as they are bewitching. Wandering the dim corridors of ancient Heavy Rock and Psychedelia, the band channels a spectral energy, part ritual, part theatre, shaping sounds that feel unearthed. Their presence carries an air of mystery and primitivity, leaving audiences haunted long after the final note fades.

events.name: LSD & The Search for God + Yumi Jun
events.description:
LSD and the Search for God kamen 2005 an die Küste Nordkaliforniens, scheinbar aus einer anderen Zeit und einem anderen Ort, und versetzten San Francisco mit hypnotischen Shows in seinen Bann, aufgebaut auf wirbelnden Gitarren, entrückten Drone-Klängen, fuzz-getränkten Popmelodien und verträumten Gesangsharmonien.

Frühe Shows und Aufnahmen wurden mit My Bloody Valentine, Slowdive, Yo La Tengo, Spacemen 3 und Sonic Youth verglichen, was der Band schnell den Ruf einbrachte, ein unverzichtbarer Act in der Underground-Shoegaze- und Psych-Szene Nordkaliforniens zu sein.

Ihre selbstbetitelte Debüt-EP LSD and the Search for God war bereits vor dem offiziellen Veröffentlichungstermin ausverkauft, wurde von Kritikern hoch gelobt und taucht bis heute regelmäßig in Listen essenzieller Shoegaze-Veröffentlichungen auf.

Alle fünf Songs festigten den Ruf der Band als wichtige Akteure des Shoegaze-Revivals der späten 2000er Jahre. Der Song Starting Over schafft einen seltenen Spagat zwischen Verletzlichkeit und Erhabenheit und hat sich über den Status eines Fan-Favoriten hinaus zu einer modernen Shoegaze-Hymne entwickelt – einer, die untrennbar mit der Bewegung verbunden ist, die sie mitgeprägt hat.

Mit wachsender Vorfreude auf ihr kultiges Debütalbum veröffentlichte die Band ihre zweite EP Heaven Is a Place, die alle Erwartungen übertraf, ihren Sound erweiterte und ihre Vision schärfte.

events.name: Sex Magick Wizards + Schiguli + Sticks in the Casino
events.description:
Beloved norwegian weirdo jazzers Sex Magick Wizards return to Berlin with new record!

Unlimited Sonic Use presents:


Sex Magick Wizards - NOR | Nice Things Records

Ft.: Ingvald Bo Vassbo (Kanaan, Full Earth, Motorpsycho)

https://sexmagickwizards.bandcamp.com/

Genre: Psychedelic Fusion Prog Jazz

FFO: Sonny Rollins, Weather Report, Kanaan, Soft Machine


Sex Magick Wizards is a Norwegian-Sámi quartet blending psychedelic rock, free improvisation and joik into hypnotic, ritualistic soundscapes. For years they have stormed Europe’s underground and experimental music scenes, earning acclaim for intense and unpredictable live performances.

The double album Suola ja Noaidi (The Thief and the Shaman) draws on themes of colonisation, weaponised religion and Sámi resilience. Working from this cultural material, Sex Magick Wizards have created a double album combining traditional joik elements with their signature experimental rock sound and freeform avant-garde improvisation. By combining fragments of Northern Sámi from the original poem with new lyrics in both English and Northern Sámi and focusing more heavily on vocals, the band creates a highly distinctive sonic language rarely heard within experimental rock. The album also contains a new interpretation of an old traditional joik from guitarist/singer/joiker Viktor Bomstad’s childhood home, Ivgorášša.

The three earlier albums released by the band "Eroto Comatose Lucidity (FBR 2019) and "Your Bliss My Joy" (Rune Grammofon, 2021) & "Death Grip" (Nice Things Records, 2024) has also attracted a lot of attention, and the band has slowly gained a reputation for its energetic, improvisatory, genre- and mind bending concerts on the european experimental rock scene.

events.name: Thronehammer
events.description:
Thronehammer ist eine internationale Doom-Metal-Band, die 2018 gegründet wurde. Die Gruppe vereint Musiker aus verschiedenen europäischen Ländern und steht für einen besonders düsteren, schweren und epischen Sound, der stark von klassischem Doom Metal geprägt ist. Kennzeichnend sind langsame, wuchtige Riffs, eine finstere Atmosphäre und der kraftvolle Gesang von Kat Shevil Gillham.

Mit ihrem Debütalbum Usurper of the Oaken Throne (2019) machte die Band schnell in der Doom-Szene auf sich aufmerksam. Es folgten weitere Veröffentlichungen wie Incantation Rites (2020), die ihren Ruf als feste Größe im traditionellen Epic Doom Metal festigten. Inhaltlich greifen Thronehammer häufig Themen wie Dunkelheit, Mystik und epische Schlachten auf und erschaffen dabei eine intensive, monumentale Klangwelt.

events.name: Ragana + Dis Fig + Spixe
events.description:
CTM presents:


A night of queer black metal intensity and crushing emotional release unfolds in a powerful double bill that opens with hardcore punk resistance.

Moving fluidly between drums, guitar, and voice, Ragana's sound is all about blurred lines. Emerging from the DIY punk underground of Olympia and now rooted between there and Oakland, the queer duo's wide spectrum of influences meld into a singular vision of experimental black metal, redolent of the petrichor and damp green moss of the Pacific Northwest. Delicate vocal harmony dissolves into searing cries, a constant push and pull between fragility and force: heavy yet luminous, grounded in emotion and carried by a sense of haunted space.

Dis Fig’s performances are full-bodied transmissions. Her live shows erase the distance between artist and audience, drawing listeners into a shared emotional terrain that extends beyond language. Her voice is an immediate snare to the senses, her presence immense. Honed across years spent in experimental scenes where boundaries were meant to be pushed, her sound spits on easy classification. It’s Rapture and Rupture, brvtal beauty flensed and stretched in uncannily melodic configurations. Continuously expanding the scope of her sound and performance, her collaborations with bass don The Bug, radical multi-disciplinary artist Tianzhuo Chen, and sonic freight trains The Body are essential listening for weird ears.

Opening the evening, Spixe brings a fierce and urgent energy rooted in Berlin’s queer punk landscape, drawing from hardcore and crust. Fronted by FLINTA voices and formed from members of Shimmer, Wet Dream War Machine, and Double Life, they channel the tensions and realities faced by marginalized communities into cutting confrontation you can mosh to, setting the tone for a night of catharsis and collective release.
